jobs.occupation: Data engineer for analytics platform with BI expertise and an interest in the green energy transition
jobs.description:
Do you want to help shape the future of Europe’s energy system and contribute to a fully carbon‑neutral, sustainable power grid? Are you a data engineer who is curious, open‑minded, and initiative-taking — someone who enjoys working in an explorative and collaborative environment? Do you want to collaborate with engineers, application developers, and data scientists to unlock insights from the vast amounts of data behind our services?

We are looking for a Data Engineer with BI expertise to join our Data and Analytics team at Nordic RCC. If you are excited about building robust data pipelines, developing high‑quality BI products, and enabling data‑driven decision‑making in a mission‑driven organization, we encourage you to apply — even if you don’t meet every requirement.

**Nordic RCC – supporting security of supply and the green energy transition

**Nordic Regional Coordination Centre (RCC) provides critical services and insights to support the national Transmission System Operators (TSOs) in Finland, Norway, Sweden and Denmark — to ensure the efficient operation and use of the Nordic power system and high security of power supply at any time.

Based in Copenhagen, Nordic RCC is one of six RCCs in Europe, equally owned by the Nordic region's four electricity TSOs: Fingrid, Statnett, Svenska Kraftnät, and Energinet.

As European power systems integrate and evolve to meet climate goals, Nordic RCC provides regional coordination, integrated services, regional insights and recommendations to the Nordic TSOs and their control centres, to support cross-border operational security 24/7.

Join Nordic RCC, a fast-developing company determined to make a significant impact in the energy sector and to provide for a secure and efficient transition to the green, sustainable energy system.

Right now, we are looking for a Data Engineer who likes to make a difference!

**Job Description

**The Data and Analytics team consists of 10 employees and consultants and plays a central role in enabling data-driven decision-making across Nordic RCC. The team develops and maintains data pipelines, analytics products, BI solutions, platform services, and information services that support operational, strategic, and regulatory needs.

As a Data Engineer with BI expertise, you will help design, build, operate, and improve our analytics platform and the data products built on it. You will work closely with data scientists, engineers, developers, infrastructure teams, external providers, and stakeholders to deliver reliable data pipelines, intuitive BI solutions, and user-friendly data services.

**Responsibilities

**Your work will directly influence how Nordic RCC uses data to improve processes, services, and operational decision-making. Your key responsibilities will include:

• Design, build, and optimize scalable data pipelines, data models, integrations, and curated datasets.

• Develop BI dashboards, reports, and data products that turn complex data into clear insights.

• Operate and improve analytics platform services, including data platforms, BI solutions, JupyterHub, user-facing analytics environments, and supporting applications.

• Ensure data quality, reliability, monitoring, and operational visibility across pipelines, BI products, and platform services.

• Monitor and optimize platform performance, resource use, computer storage, and analytical workloads.

• Collaborate with data scientists, engineers, developers, infrastructure teams, external providers, and stakeholders to deliver production-ready analytics solutions.

• Support the development of platform architecture, metadata, governance practices, and service-oriented delivery models such as Data-as-a-Service and Platform-as-a-Service.

• Document data flows, platform components, operational procedures, and technical solutions to support maintainability and knowledge sharing.

**We are looking for someone with several of the following qualifications:

**

• Minimum 5 years of experience as a Data Engineer, Analytics Engineer, BI Developer, Platform Engineer, Application Developer, or similar.

• Strong experience with ETL/ELT pipelines, modern data architectures, SQL, and data warehousing concepts.

• Hands-on experience with BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Qlik, or similar.

• Experience operating and optimizing analytics platforms in production environments.

• Experience with cloud-native technologies and analytics platforms such as Microsoft Azure, Databricks, Azure Synapse, Snowflake, or similar.

• Familiarity with orchestration, monitoring, DevOps, CI/CD, Python, containerization, Kubernetes, storage solutions, or data platform infrastructure

• Experience operationalizing analytics models, enabling data consumption, or supporting service-oriented delivery models is an advantage.

• Knowledge of power systems and the energy sector is a plus, but not a requirement.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all the listed requirements. Your experience and perspective could be exactly what we are looking for.

**Working Environment

**You will join a diverse and enthusiastic team in our office at Copenhagen Towers, Ørestad. Nordic RCC is home to over twenty nationalities, with a healthy gender balance and a wide range of ages and backgrounds. We value curiosity, fellowship, respect, and transparency—and we hope you see yourself in these values.

We offer flexible work arrangements to support a healthy work-life balance, including the option to work from home part of the time. Due to the collaborative nature of our work, physical presence in the office is expected on most days.

You’ll report to Data & Analytics team-lead and collaborate regularly with colleagues from the Nordic RCC and occasionally also from the Nordic TSOs. Travel is limited and will not exceed 15 days per year.

Nordic RCC is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

**Application & Security Clearance

**Please apply online in English no later than 5 November 2026. Interviews will be conducted on a rolling basis.

To ensure a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request that you do not include photographs in your CVs or application materials.

A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system.

Note that as part of the recruitment process, the candidate must undergo a satisfactory background check. The position is also conditioned upon a national security clearance. Both will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note that the process includes that any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to be examined.   Nordic RCC is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Join Connected Cars on our mission to connect millions of car owners with their vehicles by tapping into the on-board diagnostics available in every modern car.

About Connected Cars

Connected Cars is on a mission to transform how automotive manufacturers and distributors interact with their customers by turning vehicle data into loyal, lasting relationships. By 2030, our vision is to turn vehicle data into timely, personal moments that build trust and drive loyalty, while streamlining operations and boosting efficiency across the value chain.

Our team consists of around 70 people from diverse backgrounds and nationalities, brought together by a shared belief in team effort, community, and delivering quality products and solutions.

The Position

We are currently using Node.js (mainly TypeScript), Kubernetes, MySQL, and BigQuery on the backend, hosted on Google Cloud Platform. Having scaled our backend to a global presence, we rely heavily on Infrastructure as Code using Terraform. We believe in releasing early and often, supported by an automated CI/CD pipeline running multiple daily deployments.

Our engineers work in agile, cross-functional teams of 3–4 people with minimal overhead and bureaucracy. We empower our teams with full decision-making power over how they work, what they focus on, and how they deliver functionality.

As a Senior Backend Developer, you will architect and build robust APIs, backend services, and databases, while taking full ownership of your code from development to production monitoring (via Grafana and Google Cloud Monitoring). You will collaborate closely with other internal engineering teams and periodically communicate with external stakeholders to align on technical integrations and requirements.

What We're Looking For

We are seeking a skilled, autonomous engineer with 5+ years of professional backend experience who possesses an inquisitive mind and thrives on taking full ownership of complex problems. You are driven, enthusiastic about software engineering, and proactive in figuring out what needs to be built. Beyond technical execution, you enjoy working cross-functionally and act as a supportive mentor within your team to help colleagues find effective solutions.

Key qualifications and experience:

• 5+ years of experience as a backend engineer building scalable systems.

• Strong proficiency in Node.js, TypeScript, and building RESTful/GraphQL APIs.

• Solid experience with relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL) and managing large datasets (terabytes in BigQuery or similar).

• Proven ability to work cross-functionally and effectively communicate with external stakeholders.

• High degree of autonomy, problem-solving drive, and a natural curiosity to explore new technical solutions.

• Passion for high-quality code, TDD, CI/CD, and mentorship.

Our team is made up of people who genuinely enjoy the process of building things. If you have a GitHub account, a side project, or open-source experience, we’d love to hear about it.

Why Connected Cars

• A collaborative, innovative work environment that encourages growth, ownership, and technical autonomy.

• Competitive salary package and an attractive pension scheme.

• Friday bars, monthly social events, an affordable lunch scheme, and unlimited snacks in the office.

Connected Cars is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Please send your application through LinkedIn with an up-to-date CV. It is not necessary to provide a cover letter, but feel free to if there is extra information you think we should know.

Do you want to make a real impact by driving DevOps transformation in a fast-growing software company?

**Your new role

**As a DevOps Specialist in the Developer Enablement team at Dalux, you will play a key role in improving the developer experience and increasing productivity as we continue to scale. Your focus will be on building, evolving, and maintaining our CI/CD pipelines and supporting infrastructure, while promoting DevOps best practices and strong software engineering principles across the organization.

You will work closely with development teams to ensure that our platforms and tooling effectively support a wide range of technologies and product areas.

**Your Responsibilities

**In this role, you will:

• Continuously improve development at Dalux by proposing and implementing new ideas and evolving our systems to better support developers

• Clarify requirements and define technical and architectural solutions in collaboration with team members

• Coach and train internal users (our developers) in using the platforms and tools we provide

• Release, operate, and maintain internal components and products

• Explore, experiment, and research new technologies to identify opportunities for technical improvement

**Our DevOps platform and tech stack

**We aim to build reliable, repeatable, and highly automated pipelines, configured and maintained as code. Our shared and customizable build systems support a broad range of teams — from mobile and web applications to image processing and backend services.

Our primary technologies include:

• Jenkins (Jenkins Pipelines, JCasC)

• GitLab and Nexus (self-hosted)

• Docker

• Hyper-V

• Prometheus, Thanos and Grafana

• MSBuild

• NPM (pnpm and Vite)

• AWS (EC2, Elastic Beanstalk, CloudFormation, S3 etc.)

Builds and tests are orchestrated using Jenkins, with code hosted in GitLab. Our platforms run on both Linux and Windows.

Dalux’ continuous growth makes the environment exciting and ever changing, but is also one of the reasons why our DevOps discipline is behind where we would like it to be.

Alongside the Developer Enablement team, we have a large DevOps Guild that supports the rollout of best practices and knowledge sharing across Dalux. Our development culture is pragmatic and agile, with frequent releases. We apply the same pragmatism to DevOps — once value is demonstrated, we move quickly to implement changes.

**Your background

**We expect that you have an educational background in Software Engineering. In addition, you have either been part of driving DevOps transformations previously and see DevOps as your strongest asset. We have open positions for both experienced DevOps profiles and developers who want to specialize further in DevOps.

**Ready for the next step?

**If Dalux sounds like a place where you could make an impact while continuing to grow as a developer, we would be happy to receive your application. Interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis.

If you have any questions, feel free to contact **IT Talent Acquisition Specialist, Katrin Nedergaard +45 92909184

**This position is open on an ongoing basis due to our continuous growth. We hire multiple candidates throughout the year and keep the position open to ensure we attract the right talent as we expand.

**About Dalux?

**Dalux is a Danish software company founded in 2005 by Ph.D. Bent Dalgaard and Torben Dalgaard. Our products are designed to make the construction industry smarter and more efficient.

Using our own 3D BIM technology, Dalux develops user-friendly digital tools that are used in more than 140 countries worldwide. We are passionate about modern technology and proud to be first movers in applying new technologies - all developed entirely in-house at Dalux.

**Join our Pizza & Beer event

**Sign-up for our free Pizza & Beer event the 29th of October 2026 at Dalux from 16:00: Pizza and Beer with Dalux

During the event, you can hear more about Dalux and the career options through presentations and mingling - all while getting delicious Pizza and beer/drinks!

**Application deadline:

**Ongoing

**WHY SPEKTR

**At spektr, we are on a mission to automate the world’s most complex compliance workflows through AI. Founded by the team behind HelloFlow (acquired by Trulioo), spektr is building the infrastructure and AI agents to run compliance at scale.

_Compliance, built like product.

_Financial services has changed enormously. Much of the technology behind compliance hasn’t. Teams still spend hours on manual checks, disconnected systems slow down launches, and entering a new market can mean rebuilding the same processes all over again.

We’re changing that. spektr gives regulated businesses one platform for onboarding, monitoring and investigations, with configurable workflows and AI agents that do the legwork. Product, Operations and Compliance can move together, with the control they need to grow.

It’s a huge opportunity in an industry that has moved slowly for too long. We’ve built a product we’re proud to put in front of the most demanding customers. Now we’re looking for people who want to help get it into their hands.

• $26M raised, including a $20M Series A led by NEA, with backing from Northzone, Seedcamp and PreSeed Ventures.

• Customers worth getting excited about. We work with businesses including Pleo, Trustly, Nexi and Santander. These are large accounts with complex problems, ambitious teams and plenty of room for us to make a difference.

• Three offices: Copenhagen, London and Iași, with customers across more than 15 countries.

**THE OPPORTUNITY

**We are looking for a DevOps Engineer to join our Platform team and help us scale infrastructure, CI/CD, and observability across our growing backend ecosystem.

You will work alongside our senior platform engineers on our Kubernetes-native stack, taking ownership of real infrastructure from early on. This is a role where you'll learn by building: our environment is modern and opinionated, and you'll be running production infrastructure for financial institutions, not sandbox projects.

We are looking for someone who is genuinely curious about how systems work, comfortable being new to things, and eager to grow fast in a high-bar environment.

**What You Will Be Doing

**

• Infrastructure as Code: Build and maintain our AWS infrastructure using Terraform/Terragrunt, starting with well-scoped modules and growing into larger architectural work.

• Kubernetes Operations: Support our EKS clusters and a rapidly growing microservices environment (NestJS backend), handling deployments, troubleshooting, and day-to-day cluster health.

• CI/CD Pipelines: Build and improve pipelines with GitHub Actions in a trunk-based development environment, so deployments stay safe and fast.

• GitOps: Work with ArgoCD-driven workflows and learn to own them end to end.

• Observability: Contribute to monitoring, alerting, and dashboards, helping us catch problems before customers do.

• Collaboration: Work closely with backend engineers and security stakeholders, applying cloud security best practices with AWS-native tooling.

**What We Are Looking For

**

• The Scale-up Mindset: You thrive in fast-moving environments and prefer building systems over following manuals.

• High-Agency Learner: You dig into problems you haven't seen before instead of waiting to be shown. You ask good questions and you don't ask the same one twice.

• Foundations: 1–3 years in DevOps, SRE, Platform, or backend engineering, or equivalent hands-on experience. A Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

• Cloud & Containers: Working knowledge of AWS and Kubernetes. You don't need to be an expert yet, but you should be comfortable navigating both and understand what's happening underneath.

• Automation Instinct: Hands-on experience with Terraform or another IaC tool, and a preference for scripting something over doing it twice by hand.

• CI/CD Familiarity: You've worked with pipelines before, ideally GitHub Actions, and understand why deployment safety matters.

• Scripting & Systems: Comfortable with Linux, Git, and at least one scripting language (Bash, Python, or similar).

• Communication: You can explain what broke and why to an engineer who wasn't there.

**OUR TECH INTERESTS

**

• Cloud & Orchestration: AWS, Kubernetes (EKS), Helm

• IaC: Terraform, Terragrunt

• CI/CD & GitOps: GitHub/Gitlab, ArgoCD

• Observability: DataDog

**OUR PROCESS

**

• Intro call with our Talent team (30 minutes)

• Technical Interview (30 minutes)

• Technical Interview (60 minutes)

**How To Apply

**We hire the smartest, kindest, and most unrelenting people and let them do their best work. You’ll be joining a team with a proven track record and the "Product-Market Fit" to change an entire industry.

spektr is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, religion, disability, sexual orientation or any other characteristic, and we assess every candidate against the same role requirements.

Renewable Energy Solution Engineer – Customer & Sales Focus

( PV, BESS, Data Centers, EV, Network)

Location: Copenhagen, Denmark ( DANISH SPEAKING )

Employment: Permanent

Start: ASAP

We are looking for a Renewable Energy Solution Engineer to support technical projects within Solar PV, Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), Data Centers, EV Charging Networks and Power Distribution Networks across the Nordic region.

The role combines technical solution implementation, system integration, testing, verification and project delivery with customer engagement, partner collaboration and commercial sales support.

Responsibilities

• Take responsibility for system integration, implementation, testing, verification and project acceptance

• Support technical solution design, including platform deployment and integration verification

• Support business and system surveys for industry solution projects

• Coordinate solution implementation with customers, partners and technical teams

• Support project bidding, service solutions and sales activities across the Nordic region

• Collaborate with headquarters and Nordic teams on service solutions and sales strategies

• Support service operations, customer experience and training of service partners

Requirements

• Bachelor's degree or higher, preferably in engineering or technology

• More than 3 years of experience in the renewable energy or data center industry

• Experience in solution design, service architecture design, delivery implementation or service integration

• Experience in project support and management

• Basic service or operational experience

• Strong customer relationship skills, commercial awareness and sales awareness

• Good communication and presentation skills

• Fluent Danish and English

• Partner relationship experience and a project management background are preferred

Technical knowledge

General renewable energy industry knowledge and basic product knowledge in at least one of the following areas:

• Solar PV

• Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS)

• Data Centers

• EV Charging Networks

• Power Distribution Networks

The Company

˚MEQU is a Danish MedTech company behind the ˚M Warmer System, an innovative medical device that enables healthcare professionals to deliver warm blood and IV-fluids from the point of injury to the hospital. With customers across military, tactical, emergency, HEMS, and hospital environments worldwide, our ambition is to become the global leader in blood and IV-fluid warming solutions for pre-hospital and through hospital care. Learn more about ˚MEQU: www.mequ.dk

On behalf of ˚MEQU, Best Talent is recruiting an International Product Manager.

The Team

You will join a small, ambitious Marketing team with ambitious plans and great impact on the future growth of the company. Success is driven by close collaboration across Marketing, R&D, QA/RA, Operations, and Commercial functions in a fast moving and highly cross-functional environment.

International Product Manager

Drive global product strategy for an innovative Danish MedTech company

• Shape life-saving MedTech solutions through your clinical expertise

• Collaborate with leading healthcare providers, emergency services, and military organizations

• Play a key role in the international growth of a fast-scaling Danish MedTech company with a meaningful and global purpose

The Role

We are looking for an International Product Manager who can bridge clinical insights, users’ needs, regulatory requirements, and technical development to drive successful global product strategies and commercial execution.

You will own the global product lifecycle across emergency, tactical, and hospital segments. With the United States representing ˚MEQU’s most important growth market, you will play a key role in ensuring that product positioning, roadmap priorities, and value propositions algin with the clinical, regulatory, and commercial requirements of US military, EMS, HEMS, and hospital customers.

Working across the organization, you will ensure that user insights, market needs, engineering priorities and regulatory considerations are translated into clear product direction and commercially viable solutions.

As the internal subject-matter expert within pre-hospital blood and IV transfusion, you will convert clinical challenges into prioritized product requirements that guide product development and long-term portfolio decisions. The position reports directly to the COO and requires approximately 30-50 travel days annually.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Shaping global product positioning, value propositions, and market prioritization to support successful international expansion, and continuously monitor:

• Developments in clinical standards of care.

• Tactical and military medical protocols.

• Global procurement and reimbursement structures.

• Competitive and technological developments.

• International market dynamics and commercial opportunities.

• Develop instructions for use, training materials, user guides, and educational content to support sales teams, distributors, and clinical specialists globally.

Your professional background:

You bring a clinical background within emergency medicine, pre-hospital care, HEMS, military medicine, or tactical care, combined with hands-on experience with blood and IV transfusion in critical settings. You understand the realities and challenges faced by end users in high-pressure environments.

In addition, you have commercial insight into the MedTech industry and experience supporting product positioning, launches, and international market development. Experience working with institutional customers medical device markets and understand how to position, launch, and scale products internationally. Experience with institutional and public procurement structures is highly valued.

You understand medical device development and the regulatory environment and are able to translate complex clinical needs into structured product requirements that create both customers value and commercial impact.

Your personality – You are:

• A strong communicator with who bridges clinical technical, regulatory, and commercial perspectives.

• Commercially minded with a strategic and customer-centric approach

• Structured and analytical, with the ability to balance long-term strategy and operational execution

• Proactive, self-driven, and comfortable taking ownership in a dynamic scale-up environment

• Curious, collaborative, and motivated by improving patient outcomes through innovation

˚MEQU offers you:

You will gain international exposure across tactical, emergency, and hospital markets and collaborate closely with global distributors, armed forces, and leading healthcare institutions.

• A high-impact position with global strategic product influence

• A dynamic, international, and collaborative work environment

• A diverse team of 30+ colleagues headquartered in Copenhagen

• A mission-driven culture focused on improving patient outcomes

• Competitive salary with a pension scheme and up-to-date benefits

Application:

Please send your application in English, marked ”1947/International Product Manager” to job@besttalent.dk. Interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Learn more about Best Talent at www.besttalent.dk.

jobs.occupation: Event & Experience Manager – Bring Axlab’s customer experiences to life
jobs.description:
Can you turn a showroom visit, a reference site tour or an industry exhibition into an experience that makes a lasting impression?

In collaboration with Actief Hartmanns, Axlab is looking for an Event & Experience Manager who combines creative design with hands-on delivery and a clear commercial focus.

In the position you will own Axlab’s customer-facing experience programme: reference site visits, the headquarters showroom, Axlab Academy, and industry exhibitions. This is an opportunity to combine concept development with practical execution, shaping how visitors experience Axlab’s solutions and building the calendar, materials and processes that ensure consistent quality and continuity.

Your role goes beyond logistics: you will design welcoming, relevant experiences that help visitors understand how Axlab’s solutions work in practice. You will also build the calendar, materials and documented processes that make the programme consistent, scalable, and less dependent on any one individual.

You will be part of the Marcom team and work closely with Sales, Product Management, and external partners. Together with the Graphic Designer & Event Coordinator, you will translate ideas into a strong exhibition presence and cohesive creative execution.

What you will take ownership of

• 
Develop and deliver reference site visits, showroom tours, Academy days and exhibitions that connect customer needs with Axlab’s automated pathology workflows.

• 
Establish and continually improve the showroom experience and reference site concept for prospective and existing customers.

• 
Manage programmes and events from concept to delivery, aligning internal teams, external agencies, and production partners.

• 
Build and maintain the activity calendar, supporting materials, briefings, and documented processes.

• 
Manage suppliers, budgets, and negotiations, with close attention to production details and on-site logistics.

• 
Track event performance and work with Sales and within Marcom to ensure effective lead handling and handover.

• 
Help support the development of a sustainable webinar approach that contributes to sales opportunities.

What you bring

You have at least five years of experience in event management, experiential marketing, or customer experience, ideally combining large-scale exhibitions with smaller, hosted experiences. Exhibition or trade show experience is essential, together with relevant experience from the medical device industry. You can demonstrate that you have designed and delivered premium customer or partner experiences, not simply coordinated the logistics.

• 
A bachelor’s degree or higher in marketing, communications, business, hospitality, or event management, or equivalent experience.

• 
Experience establishing and improving a showroom for a company providing anatomic pathology equipment or a medical device company.

• 
Experience developing and refining reference site concepts for prospective and existing customers.

•

Research Associate in Next Generation Sequencing

Job Description

At Traitomic, we help companies unlock the potential of biology to create better-performing crops and microbes. Across agriculture, food and biotech, companies need biological solutions that deliver higher impact and reach the market faster. Whether starting from a genetic target, a desired phenotype or a commercial objective, Traitomic bridges the gap between biological potential and market-ready traits. Combining gene discovery, a proprietary non-GM/non-GE trait development process and deep scientific expertise, we accelerate the development of tailored crop and microbial improvements with unprecedented speed and specificity.

As part of our next phase of growth and long-term goals, we are expanding our in-house Next Generation Sequencing (NGS) and Data analysis platform in Copenhagen to support our Trait Development projects across microbial, plant, fungi and algae projects. This is a unique and challenging entry level position covering molecular biology, and more specifically, sequencing. You will be working with DNA isolations, long-read sequencing and automation, across a variety of species including microbial, fungi and plants.

As our new Research Associate in NGS, you will conduct NGS experiments and develop ownership of end-to-end sequencing projects. This will include sample reception, DNA extraction, QC and library preparations as well as other molecular biology work. You are not required to work independently from the beginning, and you will be specifically trained, but independent work is expected after a learning period.

Who Do We Imagine You Are

We’re looking for someone who wants to grow into a DNA sequencing specialist and build expertise and experience in genomics with us over time. Maybe you just graduated from your BSc. or MSc. program, and maybe you have already built some solid hands-on laboratory experience through a thesis, student job or similar. You enjoy being in the lab, getting things done and are motivated to continuously learn, rather than doing the same thing every day. Most importantly, you are curious, reliable and get motivated from dynamic environments where no two days look the same.

What You Will Do

• Extract plant and microbial DNA using commercial kits and liquid handlers

• Perform DNA quality checks, including DNA concentrations and DNA integrity tests

• Prepare manual and automated multiplexed nanopore libraries for whole genome and amplicon sequencing

• Set up, load and monitor sequencing runs for GridION and PromethION platforms, including flow cell tracking (pore QC, usage, wash and storage)

• Ensure traceability of samples from start-to-end of their sequencing life cycle, and proper documentation

• Maintenance and care of our sequencing devices and liquid handlers

• Support in lab organization, sample and reagent inventory

What We Are Looking for

• A B.Sc. or M.Sc. degree in biology, biotechnology, or a related field

• Hands-on experience in molecular biology work, specifically in DNA or RNA research. This can come from an academic thesis (BSc. or MSc.), internships and/or student jobs

• Ability to independently execute day-to-day experimental work within project objectives and priorities

• A structured approach to data recording and documentation

• A team-spirited approach to working with others, openly sharing progress and challenges, seeking input when troubleshooting, and supporting colleagues when needed

• Strong communication and organizational skills. English is the working language of the company

It would be an advantage if you have experience with:

• Academic specialization in genetics or molecular biology

• Direct exposure with sequencing workflows and protocols, ideally with Oxford Nanopore (MinION, GridION or PromethION)

• Experience in any of these: magnetic bead purification of nucleic acids, phi29 amplification of DNA, PCR and its variants, lab automation

• Data analysis in genomics

The Traitomic team

As a Research Associate at Traitomic, you will become part of a small, but highly dedicated and motivated start-up team, that unlocks the natural genetic diversity of plants and microbes with cutting-edge trait development technology. With a proactive approach and entrepreneurial mindset, you will have the possibility to help us shape, strengthen and grow Traitomic further.

Learn more about us and what we do here: https://www.traitomic.com

_**Join a team of fintech heroes! 🚀

**Performativ is changing the way investment advisors and financial institutions operate. We are building a modern platform for portfolio management, reporting, compliance, trading, and client engagement, replacing fragmented systems, manual workflows, and technology built for another era.

**As our new Software Engineer, Investment Data Integrations 📈

**You will help build and operate the systems that connect Performativ with custodians and other providers of investment data.

The immediate challenge is practical: we need to deliver a growing number of integrations while maintaining the existing portfolio and resolving real production issues. The longer-term challenge is to avoid a scaling trap where every new institution requires another collection of manual processes and bespoke code.

We are building a more automated integration platform with reusable pipelines, mappings, reconciliation, quality controls, and AI-assisted development. Your work will contribute both to integrations customers need now and to the foundations that let the team deliver future integrations faster and more safely.

• You will develop and maintain integrations covering positions, transactions, cash, instruments, prices, corporate actions, and other investment data across files, APIs, SFTP, and message-based interfaces.

• You will build reusable ingestion, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and monitoring capabilities instead of treating each provider as an isolated implementation.

• You will investigate complex data and production issues across internal systems, external providers, and customer environments, then deliver permanent fixes that prevent known classes of problems from recurring.

• You will work closely with users, operations specialists, and other engineers to understand the complete workflow and ensure that integrated data is correct and useful throughout the platform.

• You will direct AI agents to produce much of the implementation, review their assumptions and output critically, and establish the tests, controls, and evidence required for safe deployment.

You should bring strong backend or data-engineering judgment and experience with production systems where correctness and reliability matter. Experience with financial integrations, investment data, reconciliation, ETL pipelines, APIs, structured files, or regulated systems would be valuable. Familiarity with technologies such as Python, Golang, PHP, TypeScript, MySQL, Redis, AWS, and CI/CD tooling is useful, but experience with our exact stack is not essential.

AI can help us understand formats, generate mappings, develop implementations, and test integrations faster. It does not replace financial-domain understanding, careful validation, or accountability for the resulting data.

Do you know HR operations, and want to be a part of continuously optimizing our processes ?

We are looking for a People Services & Country Advisor to join our team in Kolding. You will combine hands-on HR expertise with knowledge of Danish employment legislation, and be working where local requirements, people and global HR processes meet.

People Services provides standardized services across the Vattenfall Group, and in this role, you will help ensure they work effectively in a Danish context.

What you will do

• Provide practical HR advice and guidance to employees, managers and HR colleagues

• Prepare contracts, amendments and other employment documentation

• Support payroll, time registration, pension and benefits processes

• Ensure high-quality employee data and work with SAP, SuccessFactors and ServiceNow

Qualifications

Is this you?

You have solid experience within HR Operations or a similar environment, together with good knowledge of Danish employment legislation. You enjoy solving problems, taking ownership, and turning complex HR questions into practical solutions.

You communicate confidently in Danish and English and are comfortable working across teams, functions and countries at all levels of the organization.

Experience with SAP, SuccessFactors or ServiceNow is an advantage.

An interest in, or experience using AI as a practical tool to simplify and improve HR processes would be a strong advantage.

Experience working with blue-collar employees and Danish trade unions is a preferred competence.

You will not be expected to know everything. But we do expect you to be curious enough to find out.

Most importantly, you bring drive, curiosity and the confidence to challenge how things are done and help us make them better.

Why join us?

You will join a team built on trust and honesty, where we speak up, challenge each other constructively, support one another, and, importantly, laugh a lot.

You will have real ownership, an international network and the opportunity to influence how HR services are developed in Denmark. The role also offers a hybrid working arrangement, with the possibility of working from home up to two days per week.

If you enjoy solving HR challenges, making complicated things simpler and shaping how People Services should work tomorrow, we would love to hear from you.

At Aalborg University, The Technical Faculty of IT and Design, Department of Architecture, Design and Media Technology (Copenhagen Campus) a full-time position as Postdoc is available for a period of 2 years from February 1, 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

The Department of Architecture, Design, and Media Technology has as its goal the development of an innovative cluster of engineering-based environments for education and research which integrate creativity, engineering and technology within the disciplines of architecture, urban design, industrial design, lighting design, digital design and interactive media. The department is a leading research and educational environment in Denmark that addresses the challenge of the interplay between creativity and technology and develops new areas in research and education directed towards the end-user.

Your work tasks    The successful candidate will contribute to research, supervision, teaching, and semester coordination within Lighting Design at the Department of Architecture, Design and Media Technology, Aalborg University, Copenhagen.

Research activities will be conducted with the transdisciplinary Lighting Design Lab and will primarily contribute to externally funded research projects addressing societal challenges through lighting design, technology, and human-centric approaches.

Supervision responsibilities will primarily be associated with the MSc program in Lighting Design, which includes approximately 60 international students. Students work in project groups on semester-based lighting design projects and individually or in groups on master theses. The projects are grounded in a strong understanding of design-research processes and integrate theories, methods, and approaches across relevant academic disciplines. The position will also include coordination of semesters and related educational activities.

Teaching will primarily focus on the engineering and technical aspects of lighting design, particularly within courses such as Lighting Fundamentals and Evidence-Based Lighting Design. Topics include fundamental photometric and colorimetric concepts, lighting laws and principles, measurement quantities and methods, international standards, and objective methods for the measurement, observation, analysis, and evaluation of lighting conditions.

**Your competencies

**The successful candidate is expected to demonstrate the ability to identify emerging societal challenges and translate them into future competence and skill requirements for the lighting design profession. The candidate should also demonstrate an understanding of how these competences and skills can be integrated into teaching and research in lighting design at the highest academic level.

The candidate should demonstrate the ability to attract external research funding and to lead or contribute to interdisciplinary research projects involving multiple partners and stakeholders. Experience with innovation and cross-sector collaboration between academia, industry, and public-sector organizations is considered particularly relevant.

The candidate must have experience in relevant teaching and supervising diverse student groups, with a focus on developing an understanding of transdisciplinary design processes supported by relevant technical skills and a strong scientific foundation.

The candidate must demonstrate strong collaborative skills and the ability to work effectively as part of an international and interdisciplinary team of lighting designers, architects, engineers, and other researchers within the Lighting Design Lab in Copenhagen.

Who we are

The Lighting Design Lab brings together lighting designers, engineers, architects, and researchers who work collaboratively to advance teaching and research in lighting design. The Lab supports a two-year international MSc programme in Lighting Design and a strong transdisciplinary research environment.

Our work integrates architecture, engineering, AI, and media technology and is often conducted in collaboration with private-sector partners to address relevant societal challenges. Research and experimental activities combine contextual and architectural analysis of the light environment, including daylight and electric lighting, with consideration of human visual and non-visual needs and dynamic lighting conditions.

Design solutions are based on a perceived understanding of light environments supported by advanced technologies such as lighting control, sensing systems, sky scanners, and smartphone-based applications, while remaining grounded in human and societal needs. The Lab also maintains a strong international network and collaborates with leading universities and research environments within lighting design.
